description: Creates an outgoing webhook or changes one you already have: what it fires on, where it delivers, how, and which fields it maps or filters. Take it when another system should hear about registrations, attendance or purchases: "Send every buyer to my CRM." It needs the session, and on a new one a trigger and the address your other system gave you. A webhook fires for every webinar on your site, not only this one, so that belongs in one sentence before anything is saved. The delivery address must be the receiving system itself: a public test service (webhook.site, requestbin) is refused there, because every registrant's data would be readable by anyone with the link. A test copy goes in `mirror_url` and receives fabricated sample data only, never a registrant or buyer. Turning it on needs an active plan, exactly like the form. Side effect: it writes on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: webhook, send to CRM, Zapier, connect my tool, registration trigger

active.description: true turns it on so it really fires. Default is saved but silent.

conditions.description: Field mapping and conditions: [{field, operator, value?, field_name?, field_value?}].

mirror_url.description: An optional test copy address for webhook.site. It receives fabricated sample data only (test-lead@example.com), never a registrant or buyer, because anyone with the link can read it. It turns itself off after a few hours; an empty string removes it. Setting one needs a site that reports the sample-only rule; an older plugin is refused.

name.description: The label in the webhook list. Auto-named from the trigger when left out on create.

secret.description: An optional signing secret the receiving system gave the host. Never guessed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

trigger.description: What makes it fire. Needed on create.

url.description: The receiving system's own delivery address (CRM, Zapier, Make, the host's shop). Needed on create, never invented. A public test service such as webhook.site or requestbin is refused here; that is what mirror_url is for.

webhook_id.description: 0 or left out creates a new webhook, an id changes that one.

name: wi_save_webhook
title: Save an outgoing webhook
